mapping_scope: Exhaustive top-level fields and records; nested transformation contracts below; operational data relational, original byte archive is separate.

envelope_fields.version: source_artifact.source_version and import_batch.schema_version; preserve original envelope in source_artifact
envelope_fields.records: one ordered record per collection profile; source_artifact preserves source record order

manifest_fields.purpose: source_artifact original manifest; descriptive source purpose not workflow permission
manifest_fields.source_hashes: source_artifact rows path/hash/bytes with exact full manifest archived, no invented source dates
manifest_fields.counts: immutable import_batch.report expected/actual count comparison; archive original manifest
manifest_fields.publication_ready_lessons: import_batch.report observed value 0 and checked catalog_revision readiness; never publish from count alone

nested_contracts.prerequisites.{hard,recommended,optional: three separate ordered FK tables; empty array creates zero edges; missing vs empty recoverable from artifact
nested_contracts.diagnostic.{prompt,bridge,pass}: competency_revision diagnostic fields, bridge real MODULE FK
nested_contracts.hard_edge_justifications[].{requires,sup: merge exactly by existing hard edge key; reject unknown/repeated requires; preserve both explanations
nested_contracts.items[].{kind,question,exercise_id,weigh: blueprint_item; text XOR exercise FK; preserve ordinal and source kind; sum weights100
nested_contracts.branches[].{module_id,rule}: catalog_link path_branch target and annotation; ordinal preserved
nested_contracts.rubric.{criterion_code}: rubric_criterion code and weight; array order is source property traversal but codes/values determine semantic round-trip
nested_contracts.unknowns.{field_name}: resource_unknown field/reason; no null reason silently removed
nested_contracts.original_provenance.{json_pointer,master: separate original/master/design anchors; design origin uses locator_label on hashed canonical/research artifact, never a fabricated original line
nested_contracts.provenance.{source,json_pointer,master_s: mapping_anchor for each source; selector retained verbatim as provenance_anchor.locator_label; same source location does not overwrite master counterpart
nested_contracts.original_record and original: immutable original JSON subtree retained through source_record/source_artifact exception; nested content is not interpreted as application FK graph
nested_contracts.source_hashes[].{path,sha256,bytes,lines: source_artifact path/hash/byte fields; supplementary extraction statistics/raw claimed date in immutable manifest archive, not verification columns
nested_contracts.video_timestamps: all null in supplied snapshot; accept no invented ranges; future supported ranges require schema-reviewed resource_segment migration/contract

defaults_and_new_entities: Missing title uses the exact external ID as a neutral editorial label, never an invented lesson title; source property absence retained in original artifact.
No source readiness field -> scope_outline or explicitly learning_design/project_specification by kind; no generated reviewed lessons.
R1-FND course, R1-G1..G6 executable quizzes, four-item entry diagnostic and R1-CASE-01 dossier are P02/P17 additions with source provenance, not P01 replacements.
All source artifacts including Markdown guides are registered/hash-archived; prose outside canonical collections has explicit disposition in CANONICAL_MAPPING.md.
No optional missing value is replaced by invented metadata; explicit importer defaults are recorded in immutable report and reviewed.
